macos.qualification: Complete group and Cargo result summaries cross-checked with raw logs and unchanged inventory counts. Post-run retained images do not establish which individual test used each file. Frozen and terminal runs are separate.

terminal.qualification: Complete unchanged default scenario, screen and filesystem inventories match raw reports in order. Source/ABI-matched Darwin GNU is not the frozen executable. No performance certification.

frozen.qualification: Complete frozen file/test inventory and raw outcomes, comparison issues and successful processes cross-checked. Existing expected failures and skips remain distinct from passes. Binaries and images are identified by runner provenance, not downloaded executable bytes. Darwin pin and final performance requirements remain open.

raw_integrity.status: all raw execution hashes, paired outcomes and actual GNU inputs verified

oracle_capture.qualification: Configured GNU inputs captured before validation; no test result is implied.

oracle_after_verification.qualification: Checks original and retained bytes after validation; does not change gate outcomes.

raw_integrity.qualification: Supplements the complete frozen inventory/process audit with every paired name/status/expectation and execution hash. The actual GNU executable/dump/configuration/Makefile were retained before the run and verified unchanged afterward. GNU and Emaxx each report 7670 passes, 47 expected failures and 211 skips. All 177 original compiler tests pass. The historical source244 GNU Eglot timeout remains failed evidence; this pass does not explain it. Full Linux Rust, pinned Darwin and performance remain unresolved.

trace_static.status: static and synthetic decoder checks pass
trace_static.qualification: Python ASTs, complete workflow YAML, every shell block and vector-header/block traversal checks pass. Actual GDB ABI/symbol access has not run on Linux. Ordinary macOS smoke is separate and cannot certify the observer or explain the GNU census failure.

scope.qualification: Exact source246 closes complete macOS (3096 passes/two existing ignores), terminal (226 scenarios/686 comparisons), and pinned Linux frozen (519 files/7928 outcomes/1038 successful processes). Every raw inventory/verdict and retained input hash is checked. Linux Rust remains failed on two GNU reference assertions; no cause is established. The new read-only GNU GC observer has 15 synthetic decoder checks and eight parsed shell blocks; its ordinary-only macOS smoke passes 20 processes. GDB has not run yet. Darwin pin, remaining coding/architecture/accounting/ownership work, final audit and performance remain open.

binaries: Not packaged; rebuild. Retained binary hashes identify local evidence only.
